name: Clicks Group Limited
summary: Clicks Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a health, wellness, and beauty retailer in South Africa and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Retail and Distribution. It provides retail, including Clicks, a specialist health, beauty and homeware retailer; Sorbet, a franchise of hair and beauty salons; 180 Degrees Marketing, a software development company; and The Body shop, which specializes in naturally inspired luxury toiletries, cosmetics, gifting and grooming, with stores.
